R0059.title: Trade Secret Leakage
R0059.definition: An employee discloses a company's trade secrets or sensitive information to third parties without authorization, or uses such information for personal or others' gain.
R0059.description: Scenarios include but are not limited to: departing employees taking sensitive information for competitive use, competitors stealing business or research results, internal employees leaking secrets out of dissatisfaction or greed, external attackers obtaining credentials through social engineering or cyberattacks to steal information, and employees inadvertently leaking sensitive data when using unauthorized cloud services or storage devices.
R0059.influence: May cause serious financial losses, reputational damage, and legal liability for the company.

references.title: Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the PRC - National Laws and Regulations Database

observables: An employee account accesses or downloads sensitive files in bulk before departure or during off-hours, at volumes well above the daily norm
Sensitive data is exfiltrated via personal email, cloud drives, or instant messaging, bypassing enterprise channels
Internal accounts access core trade-secret repositories from non-routine IPs or devices, with privilege usage exceeding their scope
Competitors or poaching targets surface products or proposals that closely resemble the company's confidential material
